comments: 70f4c8d9: Summary: This routine manages the checking, adding, editing, and deleting of discharge summary records for patients.
d9a54d1b: Purpose: Checks if a discharge summary report exists for a given patient (DFN) and parameters. If not, it triggers adding a new entry.
e80b5266: Initialize an output flag
aee77029: Load parameter settings from the hospital division file
7d4752d2: Exit if no parameters are defined
e0cd6ac8: Set default type to 'DISCHARGE SUMMARY' if not provided
33897e25: If report tracking entry exists but has no date/time, set flag to indicate a new report needs to be created
5446a70f: Quit if a valid IRT entry already exists for this report
7b552386: Loop through existing reports to find a match based on type and admission date
993c1182: Mark as found and quit the loop if a matching report is found
79eea9f6: If no matching report is found, proceed to add a new entry
4fd1a771: End of the checking process
f53d4995: Adds a new discharge summary entry with details from input parameters.
9d79c912: Initialize variables for the new entry
cb8b184a: Determine service section from ward location
48147690: Set service section based on hospital location if not found
cd564392: Retrieve patient movement info for the admission
93254169: Set document type codes based on parameters
dd8aac1d: If parameter set, determine additional document code
35b53276: Set event date and associated ward for the report
56cb13c3: Create a new file entry in the Discharge Summary file
87a7e99c: If file creation fails, exit
f941e208: Lock the new record for editing
561b49a0: Update the record with detailed information
872c1bc2: Perform the file update
2dcf4627: Unlock the record after updating
ea0f9b67: Set flag to indicate record has been added
471fca2e: Handles editing of discharge summaries, updating fields with new data.
8f6c290b: Lock the record for editing
4509d56f: Set fields for dictated, transcribed, signed, and reviewed dates
98e6fbb5: Update the record and recalculate the status
f6de194c: Unlock the record after editing
665ab386: End of the edit process
36aaa27d: Deletes specific fields from a discharge summary record.
a75cd078: Lock the record for deletion process
ebc89854: Clear specified fields to effectively delete parts of the record
0f8d0bb3: Update the record and recalculate status
947cf24a: Unlock the record after deletion
5b79313f: End of the deletion process
d226777b: Handles updating the signature and review sections of discharge summaries.
d5e9397a: Lock the record for signature update
e214345a: Update fields related to signatures and reviews
b69017fc: Perform the update and recalculate status
334566d6: Unlock the record after updates
3733bbe6: End of the signature update process
3f8e1d4f: Recalculates and updates the status of a discharge summary record.
2f3784a3: Initialize variables for status calculation
7450ebc8: Retrieve the current status node
1d2a3221: Set status to 'INCOMPLETE' if no dictation date
d443207a: Set status to 'DICTATED' if no transcription date
75942ac9: Set status to 'TRANSCRIBED' if no signature date
dac04369: Set status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' if review not required
ff7f009a: Set status to 'SIGNED' if no review date but signature present
08ce7333: Set status to 'REVIEWED' if review required and date present
8d04382e: Update the record with the new status
59b8510d: End of the status update process
a23c4e9a: Utility function to determine document codes based on parameters.
78260e0d: Retrieve parameter value
cf98c30b: Determine document code based on parameter value
f38c122e: End of the document code determination process
